scenes.narration: Bên chợ Bến Thành ồn ào, Lan ngồi lặng lẽ bên chiếc máy may cũ kỹ đã伴随 năm tháng.
scenes.narration_en: Among the bustling Ben Thanh Market noise, Lan sat quietly by her old sewing machine worn with time.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of a Vietnamese seamstress named Lan sitting alone at an antique wooden table in the busy Ben Thanh Market. She wears a faded apron over simple clothes, focused on fabric under natural daylight filtering through market stalls.

scenes.narration: Cô đang may chiếc áo dài trắng tinh khôi cho người mẹ già sắp lên đường sang nước ngoài.
scenes.narration_en: She sews a pristine white ao dai for her elderly mother who is about to depart abroad soon.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up vertical cinematic shot of Lan's hands carefully stitching intricate floral embroidery on pure white silk fabric. Background shows blurred busy market colors but keeps focus on the delicate sewing process under warm golden hour lighting.

scenes.narration: Linh hồn của người mẹ hiện lên qua từng đường kim chỉ, dù cô ấy chưa kịp gặp con.
scenes.narration_en: The mother's spirit emerges through every stitch and thread, even though they never got to meet properly before this moment.
scenes.image_prompt: Emotional medium vertical shot of Lan looking tearful while holding a photo frame showing an elderly Vietnamese woman smiling. The background features soft bokeh lights from market lanterns creating a nostalgic atmosphere with warm evening glow.

scenes.narration: Gió chiều吹过, mang theo hương hoa sữa và tiếng gọi da diết của lòng mẹ.
scenes.narration_en: The evening breeze carries the scent of jasmine flowers and the urgent call of a mother's heart across distances.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic wide shot showing Lan standing by her window overlooking Ben Thanh Market at dusk. Soft purple and orange sky reflects on wet cobblestone streets with gentle wind blowing cherry blossom petals around her figure.

scenes.narration: Chiếc áo hoàn thành, mang theo tình yêu thương vô hạn để tiễn mẹ đi xa mãi.
scenes.narration_en: The completed ao dai carries infinite love to see off the mother on her distant journey forevermore.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic close-up of the finished white ao dai draped elegantly over a wooden mannequin with subtle embroidery details visible. Soft natural light highlights fabric texture while blurred market activity creates depth in Vietnamese urban setting.

scenes.narration: Lan bước ra khỏi cửa hàng, biết rằng tình mẫu tử sẽ vượt qua mọi khoảng cách.
scenes.narration_en: Lan steps out of her shop knowing that maternal love will transcend all distances between them eternally.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic full-body shot of Lan walking away from traditional Vietnamese tailor shop door holding finished ao dai gently. Warm sunset light creates silhouette effect against busy Ben Thanh Market background with emotional atmosphere.
